svg.title: Prime record sequences and published gap primes
svg.desc: Six color-coded sequences show prime p against term number n. The vertical axis is logarithmic. The dashed blue gap segment continues from 64 scanned terms to 85 published terms.
svg.text: Prime p at term n · dashed blue continues gap A002386 beyond our scan
